fil: Network Designer: Screenshot (PNG) ng nakikita sa screen o ng buong design
Network Designer: I-download ang plan bilang CCNA Lab (.json), GNS3 (.gns3), draw.io (.drawio) o mga config (.txt) para sa Packet Tracer; at i-upload ang .json, .gns3 o .drawio
Auto-design: inaayos na rin ang puwesto ng mga device (Internet → firewall → router → core → switch → mga end device)
Lahat ng floor plan ay pwede nang walang hanggan (lumalaki habang nagdidisenyo), may sukat ng workspace at ng bawat shape, at bagong Custom shape na nababago ang mga kanto
Premium: maayos na ang layout ng bayad, at may sariling QR ang GCash, Maya at GoTyme
Download: wala nang link box; sa loob na ng app nagda-download ang Full installer
en: Network Designer: a screenshot (PNG) of what is on screen or of the whole design
Network Designer: download the plan as CCNA Lab (.json), GNS3 (.gns3), draw.io (.drawio) or configs (.txt) for Packet Tracer; and upload a .json, .gns3 or .drawio
Auto-design now also arranges where the devices go (Internet → firewall → router → core → switches → end devices)
Every floor plan can now be unlimited (grows as you design), with the size of the workspace and of every shape shown, and a new Custom shape with editable corners
Premium: a tidier payment layout, and GCash, Maya and GoTyme each have their own QR
Download: no more link box; the Full installer downloads inside the app
